record.original_question: Characterize completely the intervals [σ, τ] in the permutation pattern poset whose Möbius function satisfies μ(σ, τ) = 0.

evidence.quote: Although many families of intervals [σ, τ] with µ(σ, τ) = 0 are described in [19, 46], it is an open problem to characterise such intervals completely.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the permutation pattern poset P, whose elements are all finite permutations (one for each length n ≥ 1, viewed as sequences σ = σ(1)σ(2)…σ(n) of distinct positive integers, considered up to order-isomorphism so that we may take σ to be a permutation of {1,2,…,n}). The order is pattern containment: for σ of length k and τ of length n, write σ ≤ τ if there exist indices 1 ≤ i_1 < i_2 < … < i_k ≤ n such that the subsequence τ(i_1)τ(i_2)…τ(i_k) is order-isomorphic to σ (i.e., τ(i_a) < τ(i_b) iff σ(a) < σ(b)). For σ ≤ τ the closed interval is [σ,τ] = {π : σ ≤ π ≤ τ}, and the Möbius function μ on P is defined recursively by μ(σ,σ) = 1 and, for σ < τ,
   μ(σ,τ) = − ∑_{σ ≤ π < τ} μ(σ,π).

Problem. Give a complete characterization of all intervals [σ,τ] in this poset for which μ(σ,τ) = 0. That is, determine necessary and sufficient combinatorial conditions on the pair (σ,τ) for the Möbius function of the interval [σ,τ] to vanish.
artifact.category_tag: Möbius function of permutation pattern poset
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of completely characterizing intervals [σ,τ] in the permutation pattern poset with μ(σ,τ) = 0 remains open. Substantial partial progress exists: many sufficient conditions for vanishing have been identified (e.g., presence of consecutive monotone triples; two non-order-isomorphic length-2 intervals; mixed ascent/descent intervals), and a two-term formula whose second term often vanishes has been developed. Asymptotic lower bounds (e.g., proportion ≥ (1−1/e)² for principal intervals) have been proven, but no complete characterization has appeared.

status_evidence.title: Zeros of the Möbius function of permutations (Mathematika)
status_evidence.snippet: Identifies broad families of intervals where the Möbius function vanishes and proves asymptotic lower bounds for the proportion of zero principal intervals.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial sufficient conditions for μ = 0 are known; no complete characterization.

status_evidence.title: A formula for the Möbius function of the permutation poset based on a topological decomposition
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a two-term formula whose second term is conjecturally zero in many cases but not all.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work still pursues structural understanding rather than a full characterization of zero intervals.

status_evidence.title: On the Möbius Function of Permutations Under the Pattern Containment Order (PhD thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys known partial results and sufficient conditions for μ(σ,τ)=0; the complete characterization is described as still unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Complete characterization of zero Möbius intervals remains an open problem.
